_about: First-run hints (design §7b). DATA, not code: harness/hints.py serves them, the room shows the first one not yet done as a card. `open` is the window 'Show me' opens; `done_when` is the action that marks it done ('open:<window id>'), so a hint goes away when you DO the thing, not only when you dismiss it. Edit the words freely; ids are what progress is stored against.

hints.title: This is her room
hints.body: Talk to her in Chat. She remembers what you tell her, speaks up on her own when she has a reason, and keeps a journal of her own. These cards show you around; each goes away once you have tried the thing it is about.

hints.title: Who she is is yours to shape
hints.body: Persona shows her as titled sections — how she talks, what she cares about, her limits. Edit any of them, add your own, or use Character to answer a few questions instead. Changes apply from her next session.

hints.title: What she remembers
hints.body: Tell her things about you and she keeps them. Memory shows every fact, who said it, and why she believes it (the why button). Nothing is ever deleted: a fact that changes is retired, and you can see what she used to think.

hints.title: Off the record
hints.body: The person icon at the bottom right is off-the-record. While it is on she is entirely herself, but nothing is written down: no memory, journal or transcript.

hints.title: Her journal and her own time
hints.body: When the room is quiet she has time of her own, and once a day she writes a line in her journal. You can read them (Journal, Her own time); you cannot write in them. They are hers.

hints.title: Her face and her clothes
hints.body: She starts with the default face and one outfit. Wardrobe is where new looks arrive and where she chooses what to wear. To give her a face of her own, put a description in character.txt and a reference image in her avatar folder, then generate — this needs an image key (Setup).

hints.title: Her voice
hints.body: She speaks with the local voice on this machine — offline and free. Voice switches her to a provider voice (needs a key) or turns speech off.

hints.title: Back her up, and undo
hints.body: Companion saves her as a bundle you can keep or move, loads or resets her personality and history, and undoes the last change. A reset never deletes anything.

hints.title: What is and is not set up
hints.body: Setup checks your model endpoint and keys and says exactly what is missing. Models shows every model she runs on.
